about: Every saved page under tests/fixtures/, cut down by scripts/reduce-fixture.ts (D-24). savedAt is when the one manual request was made (UTC). `refresh --fixtures` builds the sample data from the entries marked sample; the others are for parser tests only.

fixtures.why: Kept out of the sample until Silverbird's Veezi reader replaces Lagocine for Ikeja (D-76): Veezi writes some titles differently from Lagocine, so running both would list the same showing twice.
Abuja sample data (D-120): Silverbird Entertainment Centre, read only through its own Veezi page, so no other source lists it twice.
